data.jobDescription:
UK CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION: Yes

RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Requisition ID: R10214355
Location: New Malden, London
Citizenship Required: UK citizenship required
Clearance Type: SC
Hybrid / On Site: On site
Travel Required: Yes, up to 10%
Relocation Assistance: Not available
Positions Available: Multiple
Hours: Full-time (12-month placement starting September 2026)
Salary: £25,000

What’s your possible?

At Northrop Grumman UK, you are part of a team driving innovation where it matters most – solving tomorrow’s challenges and shaping the technology solutions of the future. It’s what we call Defining Possible.

This mindset goes beyond our customer solutions; it’s the foundation for your career development and the impact we have within the community.

This is more than just a job; it’s a mission.

Are you ready to work on critical technology that powers the UK’s submarines?

As an Industrial Placement Systems Engineer, you’ll join our Integrated Systems team, contributing to the design and development of Platform Management Systems (PMS) for the UK’s fleet of nuclear-powered submarines. You’ll be part of a multi-disciplined project team, supported by a dedicated mentor, buddy, project lead, and line manager throughout your 12-month placement.

This is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience in defence technology, working on real-world challenges that have national significance.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Support Systems Engineering activities across the full lifecycle – from requirements to acceptance.
  • Assist in delivering project SE outputs and continuous process improvements.
  • Monitor task progress and report against agreed budgets and schedules.
  • Apply approved plans, processes, and procedures to SE activities.
  • Contribute to project reviews including design, risk, and change impact assessments.
  • Support issue management and ensure compliance with safety and security regulations.

What we’re looking for:

  • Working towards a degree in Electronics, Mechanical, Systems or Software Engineering.
  • Understanding of Systems Engineering principles, including Verification and Validation.
  • Familiarity with requirements management tools such as DOORS.
  • Knowledge of verification methods and control systems.
  • Proficient in MS Office applications (Word, Visio, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Confident communicator, able to present to internal and external stakeholders.

If you don’t meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be exactly who we’re looking for – either for this role or another opportunity at Northrop Grumman UK.

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our work, you must be a sole UK national to be eligible for this position. You must be able to gain and maintain SC level UK Government security clearance.

Our recruitment team is here to support you through the process: talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com

Benefits

  • Flexible working options, including compressed fortnight (every other Friday off)
  • Private healthcare
  • Cash health plan
  • Holiday buy/sell scheme
  • Career development programmes
  • Performance bonuses

Why join us?

A Mission to Believe In – Work on cutting-edge submarine technology that powers the UK’s future defence capabilities.

A Place to Belong and Thrive – Every voice matters. Find community and belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and get involved with STEM volunteering events.

Your Career, Your Way – Discover your possible with diverse roles, mentorship, and development opportunities tailored to your ambitions.

Ready to apply?

Yes – Submit your application online.
Possibly – Reach out to our team for more information: Earlycareers@uk.ngc.com
No – Explore other opportunities with us. We’re growing across the UK.
